Some phones close apps in the background to save battery and the cast stops. These three steps prevent it.
ColorOS (OPPO, realme, OnePlus): allow «Auto launch» and set battery to «Allow background activity». Reinstalling the app resets these settings.
MIUI / HyperOS (Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO): enable «Autostart» and set Battery saver to «No restrictions».
One UI (Samsung): in Battery, set the app to «Unrestricted» and remove it from «Sleeping apps».
Allow the app to run in the background without battery restrictions.

This browser is for websites (for example twitch.tv). Open the site, start the video and it will show up below, ready to send.
Is the video in another app? HPlay cannot see inside other apps. Open HPlay Receiver on the PC or TV and use that app\'s own cast/TV button. If it has none, use «Mirror screen».
